'''2010 Worlds Day 2 Rick Zuchowski DS Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Rick Zuchowski]] at [[2010 World Championship]] (Day 2).

Deck name on sheet: Pilfin's Hunt Down non-V.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe]]
* '''Username:''' Pilfin
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
